title: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium in Polyploids
text: Inference concerning equilibrium random mating autopolyploids. Methods available test equilibrium random mating even ploidy level (>2) presence double reduction biallelic loci. autopolyploid populations equilibrium, methods available estimate degree double reduction. also provide functions calculate genotype frequencies equilibrium, one several rounds random mating, given rates double reduction. details methods, see Gerard (2023a) <doi:10.1111/biom.13722> Gerard (2023b) <doi:10.1111/1755-0998.13856>. main functions inference : hwefit(): Fit either hwelike(),rmlike(), hweustat(), hwenodr(), hweboot() across many loci. Parallelization supported future package. hwelike(): Likelihood inference equilibrium. function estimates rate double reduction given equilibrium, tests small deviations equilibrium. rmlike(): Likelihood inference random mating polyploids. function tests random mating estimates gametic frequencies given random mating. function assume model meiosis. hweustat(): U-statistic approach equilibrium double reduction. function tests equilibrium given double reduction rates estimates rates given equilibrium. hwenodr(): Implements likelihood ratio test tests Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium autopolyploids given double reduction. hweboot(): Implements bootstrap approach test equilibrium appropriate small samples uncertain genotypes. rmbayes(): Implements Bayesian test random mating autopolyploids ploidy level. rmbayesgl(): Bayesian test random mating, accounting genotype uncertainty using genotype likelihoods. menbayesgl(): Bayesian test Mendelian segregation frequencies S1 F1 populations using genotype likelihoods. Functions provided calculating genotype frequencies individuals gametes: gsegmat(): Produces segregation probabilities gamete dosages given parental dosages double reduction rate. gsegmat_symb(): Provides symbolic representation output gsegmat(). zsegarray(): Obtains offspring genotype probabilities given parental probabilities, ploidy species, overdispersion parameter, possible parental genotypes. freqnext(): Updates genotype frequencies one generation random mating. hwefreq(): Calculate genotype frequencies equilibrium. bounds double reduction rate complete equational segregation model provided drbounds().
